title: Doubles bowling tournament check-in

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: A reminder for pairs in Sunday's doubles bowling tournament. Check in together at the scoring desk by ten thirty. If your partner is late, tell the desk as soon as you arrive. You can practise on a free lane while you wait, but your first tournament game won't start without both players. We've moved the shoe exchange next to lane six; the old counter is being used for score sheets. Please keep your receipt if you rent shoes. The desk will refund the rental charge if your own shoes are damaged during a tournament game and you rent shoes from the centre. Shoes rented before your first tournament game, including rentals for practice, are not refundable.
turns.zh: 提醒參加星期日保齡球雙人賽的各組選手：請最晚十點半兩人一同到計分櫃檯報到。如果搭檔遲到，請一抵達就告知櫃檯。等待時可以在空球道練習，但兩人都到齊才會開始第一場正式比賽。換鞋處搬到了六號球道旁，舊櫃檯現在用來處理計分表。若租鞋請保留收據。如果自備球鞋在正式比賽中損壞，因而向球館租鞋，櫃檯會退還租金。第一場正式比賽開始前租的鞋不退費，包括為了練習而租的鞋。
